topPRs.title: feat(context): progressive authorized content access and evidence
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Implements the progressive authorized content-access architecture for issue #26645. Model-facing content is preserved through typed references, exact bounded reads, revision-bound continuations, native source segments, central projection, final-wire admission, and explicit rejection instead of silent truncation.

The implementation covers files, documents, memory/message text, email/Gmail, attachments, and shell/tool output; adds deterministic six-family scale corpora; and unifies conformance, mutation, fault, scenario, E2E, PostgreSQL, benchmark, resource, cleanup, and soak evidence.

Design and research:
- docs/design/context-content/progressive-content-access-spec.md
- docs/design/context-content/progressive-content-access-research-and-test-report.md
- docs/design/context-content/progressive-content-access-goal.md

## Exact-head evidence

SHA: `5e2eef8762d2eb84dcdeb2cb421f2062f9fc4355`

Passing at this SHA:
- `bun run verify`
- 40/40 adversarial evidence-validator tests
- 90-process / 5-repetition benchmark across 18 family-size coordinates
- real PostgreSQL target matrix with indexed seek plans and verified database deletion
- real local context-inspector API/UI/E2E with redaction and database readback
- full 231-test app visual audit
- SQL and PGlite progressive-content integration suites

The required six-hour / 100,000-operation soak is running at this exact SHA and must finish before merge. Credentialed live-model trajectories also require explicit controller/judge model and pricing configuration; no missing-credential lane is represented as a pass.

## Review notes

PRs #24020 and #24017 were re-reviewed and remain closed with changes requested; their surrogate-safe previews do not solve irreversible model-facing truncation. This PR is the lossless continuation architecture and evidence layer instead.

topPRs.author: wtfsayo
topPRs.body:
# Relates to

Operator-requested canonical design-system consolidation following the closed exploratory PR #26518.

- [x] This PR targets `develop` and is rebased onto the latest `origin/develop` with zero conflicts.
- [x] `bun install` and `bun run verify` were run after sync.
- [x] A reviewer can confirm the change from the evidence below.

# Sync with develop

- [x] Rebased onto `origin/develop` at `49f190e29bd4b8c56dc9ff6c65fbf9ce21ff1473`; zero conflicts.
- [x] `bun run verify` passes post-sync at PR head `e0bbc17fc493c782b9a8cdbf9a805cc8996c433d`.

# Risks

Medium. This deliberately touches shared UI primitives and many consumers. The main risk is visual regression across compact/mobile layouts. The fail-closed design gate, full Story Gate, app audit, focused interaction stories, typecheck, lint, and root verification cover that surface.

# Background

## What does this PR do?

Establishes a canonical design-system boundary for product UI:

- Adds semantic token roles and restricts which component kinds may consume them.
- Adds canonical molecules for repeated structures: content states, settings rows, selectable tiles, action-list rows, and status badges.
- Migrates raw controls, duplicate atoms, deep imports, visual overrides, off-token colors, and equivalent recipes to their canonical owners.
- Uses a quiet 1 px semantic divider for table/list separation instead of boxed rows.
- Fixes compact landscape rendering, including centered selectable-tile copy without redundant `ON` text and the clipped white Today panel.
- Adds a fail-closed audit with ratcheted inventories so new violations cannot silently reappear.

## What kind of change is this?

Improvement and non-breaking feature.

## Why?

Visually equivalent controls had accumulated independent spacing, border, color, selection, and state treatments. That produced inconsistent tables and settings rows and made local fixes easy to regress. This change encodes the ownership rules in components, semantic tokens, inventories, and CI checks.

# Documentation changes needed?

Updated `packages/ui/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md`, the package guides, and generated design-system inventories.

# Testing

## Where should a reviewer start?

1. Read `packages/ui/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` for the token/component ownership rules.
2. Review the canonical molecules and their Storybook states.
3. Run the design-system audit and inspect the visual evidence below.

## Detailed testing steps

```bash
bun run --cwd packages/ui audit:design-system
bun run --cwd packages/ui typecheck
bun run --cwd packages/ui lint
bun run --cwd packages/app audit:app
bun run verify
```

Results:

- Design-system gate: 21/21 tests; 1,246 governed files; all 11 violation classes at zero.
- Full Story Gate: 1,636/1,636 stories good; 0 broken; 0 accessibility failures.
- Focused capability-handoff Story Gate: 3/3 good; 1/1 play interaction; 0 console or accessibility errors.
- App audit: 227/227 Playwright paths; 0 `needs-work`; 0 broken; OCR 212 verified and 12 manual-review captures.
- Exact-head root `bun run verify`: passed.

topPRs.title: test(launch-qa): add staging resource certification ledger
topPRs.author: standujar
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- Adds a canonical, public, redacted staging resource ledger with 56 opaque resources.
- Encodes the actual product model: team-maintained shared provider ingress, central onboarding gate, Personal Shared or Dedicated routing, and exactly one onboarded owner per group.
- Adds a strict schema, generated human-readable view, adversarial checker tests, root launch-QA wiring, and a PR smoke gate.

## Current certification truth

- **56 resources inventoried**
- **0 resources READY**
- **56 private resolvers MISSING**
- The evidence snapshot belongs to staging API commit `de774b875774f478ef5b879dbdae8fd2997a3470`.
- The current observed staging deployment is `094f80ad2ded8fdd78da8664ccf3423590f1c25a`, observed from the public staging health authority after the canonical release.
- The ledger therefore reports `REVALIDATION_REQUIRED`, and every prior verdict is visibly historical.

The model requires provider-backed smoke evidence for unlinked first contact → central login → post-link chat in the same provider conversation. A graph route alone cannot certify that journey.

## Safety and integrity

- READY requires fresh resolver, custody, provider, runtime, smoke, and deployment-bound evidence.
- READY claims require a short-lived Ed25519 authorization signed over the complete redacted READY payload.
- YAML ambiguity, private locators, mock evidence, stale evidence, unknown fields, noncanonical order, broken ownership/routes, and partial generated-artifact publication fail closed.
- Signing-window tests derive their clock from the newest ledger observation, so a legitimate deployment refresh cannot invalidate the fixture through a stale hardcoded time.
- This change performs no account, OAuth grant, provider bot, group, message, database, secret, or deployment mutation.
- `packages/cloud/api/test/README.md` is intentionally untouched because PR #27870 owns that correction.

## Verification

- `bun run test:launch-qa`: 59 passed, 0 failed
- Focused Biome check: passed
- `actionlint .github/workflows/pr-static-smoke.yml`: passed
- `git diff --check`: passed
- Real ledger check: 56 resources, 0 READY, 0 errors

topPRs.title: fix(context): remove remaining silent model-content caps
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
Closes #26992.

## Outcome

Removes silent model-facing character, item-count, history, result, diagnostic, and output-token caps across runtime prompts, document reads/listing, connector message history/search, inbox/subscription scans, stored messages, attachments, action results, exports, diagnostics, and training paths.

The repository invariant is explicit and enforced: preserve complete context; use lossless ordered transport chunks; expose explicit caller pagination with truthful continuation; or reject before dispatch at a real external boundary. Do not summarize, compact, slice, retain only recent items, or invent output limits for model-facing content.

## Notable changes

- deletes automatic conversation compaction, `/compact`, and prompt-slicing utilities
- removes implicit provider/action/history/search/read caps across connector, document, inbox, browser, diagnostics, memory, and model paths
- exhausts provider cursors when callers omit pagination; explicit pagination remains caller-controlled and carries truthful continuation metadata
- keeps complete prompt/response logs, exports, task clipboard items, stored facts, and model outputs
- replaces externally enforced limits with typed reject-before-dispatch behavior instead of rewriting authored content
- rejects oversized training rows instead of truncating or guessing mask alignment
- adds a repository source guard against restoring reviewed caps, compaction modules, token truncation, or duplicate guard keys

## Reversion audit

The linked GitHub audit closed 44 cap-preserving or duplicate PRs, including follow-ups that only made an existing truncation Unicode-safe while retaining the data loss. UI-only previews, externally required protocol fields, explicit caller pagination, and lossless ordered chunking were retained after inspecting their actual consumers. Newly opened duplicate #28238 was also closed.

## Exact-head evidence

Validated against `origin/develop` `8d3f113a4034fbc4d23cc4b67f8ff7fc0e72f9d9` at candidate head `a36b6556f52d9296099ce0fe7170318702dd7d71`:

- prompt-integrity policy, document, and clipboard regressions: 26/26
- encrypted agent export/import round trip, including 501 losslessly paged logs: 11/11
- hosted-search JSON boundary: 4/4 tests, 9 assertions
- hosted exact-head PR Static Smoke: https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/actions/runs/32824212732 (source affected lint/typecheck/build, Windows security, aggregate gate all passed)

The independent clone also installed the pinned workspace and built the private logger/shared/core prerequisites before running the affected typecheck; hosted CI is the authoritative final gate.
